response.sql:
WITH country_avg AS (
  SELECT c.country AS country,
         AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points,
         AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM constructorStandings cs
  JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId
  JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  WHERE c.country IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.country
)
SELECT country,
       avg_points,
       avg_wins,
       avg_wins - (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) FROM country_avg) AS wins_minus_mean_of_country_avg_wins
FROM country_avg;

assumptions.assumption: Each constructorStandings row is attributed to the country of its race's circuit (constructorStandings.raceId -> races.circuitId -> circuits.country), and the per-country averages are AVG over all such rows, so AVG's default NULL handling implements 'ignoring missing values'.

Rows whose circuit has a NULL country are excluded, since they do not belong to any country; the simple mean is AVG over the per-country average wins, so each country counts once and countries whose average wins is NULL are skipped.
